proofs.argument: The initial +/- makes cell zero nonzero. Each iteration moves right to a fresh zero cell and changes it by +/-1 modulo 2^b. That cell is nonzero for b=4 or 8, so ] always jumps back to >. By induction the pointer strictly increases and execution never exits the loop on the right-unbounded tape. A resource stop does not change this model-level argument.
